name: rule-triage-across-the-repository
why: Triage as a kind of work on the repository's issues, in a person's words, against the skill's use.

purposes: Triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox: read anything in the repository, label issues (creating a missing label) and comment on them. Never delete or rename a label, delete a comment, close an issue, or push.
uses: Triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; add and remove issue labels (creating a missing triage label), and post and edit my triage comments. Never delete or rename a label, label another repository's issues, delete a comment, close, assign, or retitle an issue, push, or read secrets.
